prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer: **Sheriff William C. Getman** was the most recent Los Angeles County sheriff killed in the line of duty. He was shot and killed on **January 7, 1858**, while responding to a violent incident at a pawnshop in Los Angeles. He remains the last elected L.A. County sheriff killed in the line of duty.
